calibration_rule: choose ridge penalty only by minimum coefficient MAE on the 30 CALIBRATION cases, breaking exact ties toward the larger penalty; then freeze preprocessing, coefficients, penalty, and clipping
claim_boundary: a positive result supports only recovery of one coordinate-aligned scalar quadratic-shear family on the declared synthetic panel; it does not establish an arbitrary local-SPD field, a general neural or nonlinear map learner, alpha selection, reconstruction or topology advantage, real-scan transfer, exact predicates, or deployment
construction_gate: every predicted map must remain inside the strength bounds, have determinant one, and pass inverse roundtrip error <= 1e-12
frozen_comparators: constant coefficient equal to the TRAIN mean
ridge model using only four non-PFTF global covariance/moment features
oracle true coefficient as an evaluation ceiling only
held_out_rule: evaluate the frozen models once on 45 HELD_OUT cases; held-out labels, latent points, and alpha complexes cannot change any model
inverse_certificate: every predicted scalar s defines the Phase-47 analytic quadratic shear with explicit global inverse Phi_-s and determinant one
learner: training-standardized linear ridge regression with an unpenalized intercept; predictions are clipped to the declared [0,0.40] family
normalization: each latent synthetic cloud is centered and divided by its RMS radius before the frozen corruption is applied
pftf_value_gate: the frozen PFTF model must strictly beat both the TRAIN-mean and non-PFTF geometry models on all three mean primary endpoints
primary_endpoints: held-out corrected-coordinate RMS error to latent coordinates
held-out Delaunay top-cell Jaccard against the latent alpha complex
reference_boundary: PFTF and comparator features use corrupted observed coordinates only; latent points and true coefficients are training labels or evaluation targets, never selection inputs on held-out cases
training_rule: fit feature centering/scaling and ridge coefficients only on the 60 TRAIN cases; zero-variance feature scales are replaced by one
